context: Evaluates correct usage of the wormhole navigation context provider within a React Three Fiber scene. Tests that the provider is mounted in the right context and that all three callback props (onSpeedChange, onActionsReady, onWarpStateChange) are correctly wired and receive the expected arguments.

checklist.name: Provider Import
checklist.description: WormholeProvider is correctly imported from the timeverse package and used as the root wrapper inside the R3F Canvas context

checklist.name: onSpeedChange Wiring
checklist.description: The onSpeedChange callback is passed to WormholeProvider and fires with a numeric speed value (normalized -1 to 1 range)

checklist.name: onActionsReady Wiring
checklist.description: The onActionsReady callback receives an object containing exactly stop, toggleCameraMode, and initiateWarp function references

checklist.name: onWarpStateChange Wiring
checklist.description: The onWarpStateChange callback is passed and receives isWarping (boolean), warpPhase (string), and warpIntensity (number) arguments

checklist.name: Children Rendering
checklist.description: The provider correctly renders its children prop, allowing scene components to be composed inside it
